failure.rootCause: Direct native editing-state synchronization did not fix this. Framework inspection identifies a retained focusedEditable cache in the live test binding: after unfocus, showKeyboard called for the identical field skips requestKeyboard, leaving injected text without an active client. Host text-input clear resets this cache; the live native binding does not. Current helper explicitly taps the actual EditableText before injection and asserts the corrected text before/after blur. No product validation was weakened.
